objective: Reduce unnecessary local-model memory and remove synchronous Agent timeouts while preserving MCP execution and desktop capabilities
acceptance_criteria: Dirty original checkouts can fast-forward to an exact enrolled commit without overwriting local edits or invoking a model
Computer tasks return durable accepted receipts immediately and run independently of MCP transport
Bounded shared MCP inference lane limits concurrent model jobs while deterministic tasks remain independent
Existing operation receipts and uncertain no-replay guarantees remain compatible
Model residency and actual execution routing are observable without loading models
Regression tests and runtime/catalog deployment status are documented and pushed
